summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Ultrapar Holdings Inc., a foreign private issuer, reporting its individual and consolidated interim financial information for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes statements of financial position, income, comprehensive income, changes in equity, cash flows, and notes, along with minutes of a board of directors meeting. It is a routine periodic financial report, not a special situation. No transaction, activist activity, or strategic event is disclosed. The filing serves as a standard update to the SEC for foreign issuers.
